rules.Color(0x): Raw hex colors are forbidden. Use semantic tokens from ui/theme/Color.kt.
rules.Color.(White|Black|Gray|Red): Raw Color constants are forbidden. Use TextPrimary, Background, Error, etc.
rules.RoundedCornerShape(): Raw shapes are forbidden. Use ShapeS, ShapeM, ShapeL, or ShapeFull from ui/theme/Shape.kt.
rules.fontSize =: Raw font sizes are forbidden. Use AppTypography styles from ui/theme/Type.kt.
rules.n.sp: Raw sp dimensions are forbidden. Use AppTypography styles from ui/theme/Type.kt.
rules.MaterialTheme.typography: Use AppTypography.* tokens directly instead of MaterialTheme.typography.
rules.Toast.makeText: Toasts are forbidden. Use AppSnackbarHost and AppSnackbar with optional Undo.
rules.bouncyClickable: Deprecated bouncyClickable is forbidden. Use Modifier.pressable instead.
rules.deprecatedAliases: Deprecated color aliases (VelvetBlack, PureWhite, etc.) are forbidden outside incognito.
rules.clickableWithoutContentDescription: Clickable elements must have an accessible contentDescription.
